cpu.inclusiveConvention: Distinct source-frame membership per sampled stack; recursive identical source locations counted once. Includes descendants, overlaps other functions.
cpu.scope: Whole Node process. Reached unique ancestor categories are stack observations, not exact timed shares; GC/omitted/shared frames cannot be assigned to an interval.

allocation.inclusiveConvention: Distinct source-frame membership per sampled stack; recursive identical source locations counted once. Includes descendants, overlaps other functions.
allocation.scope: Collected-inclusive V8 sampling estimate over preload sampling lifetime (before artifact require through exit hook); not exact allocated bytes, live heap, RSS or timed-only allocation. Setup/final rendering remain included; instrumentation itself may contribute.
